paper_title: Endothelial dysfunction and long-term survival in cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic syndrome stages 0-3: An EASIX-based national cohort study
study_design: Retrospective analysis of prospectively collected NHANES 1999-2018 baseline data linked to mortality through 2019; complete-case primary survey-weighted Cox analysis with spline, subgroup and sensitivity analyses.

context: Ten NHANES cycles, complete-case selection and public-use mortality linkage.
